title: Apollo Skill Eval — cases.json
description: Schema for per-skill eval/cases.json files. Each skill MUST have one cases.json conforming to this schema. The replay-eval scorer reads this to drive narrative_doc-based description-match scoring.

skill.description: Skill name. Must match the directory under .claude/skills/<skill>/ and the `name:` field in SKILL.md frontmatter.

version.description: Cases-file schema version. Bump when the case schema (not the skill) changes.

description_match_threshold.description: Minimum description-match score (0..1) for a case verdict to count as `pass`. Default suggested: 0.35. Calibration evidence in eval/replay/threshold-calibration.md.

cases.description: Eval cases. Skill MUST have ≥5 cases (4 positive + ≥1 negative) to pass support gate.

gate.description: Optional explicit gate block. If absent, framework defaults are applied (precision ≥0.85, FPR ≤0.15, support ≥5; destructive lane raises precision floor to 0.95).

narrative_doc.description: Filename of the narrative_doc relative to eval/. Required for positive cases (cases that should activate the skill). Null only for negative / out-of-scope cases.

user_message.description: The exact message a user would send to trigger (or attempt to trigger) the skill.

should_activate.description: Whether the skill SHOULD activate on this input. Negative cases set this false.

expected.description: Expected behaviors. All non-`should_activate` keys are skill-specific assertions verified by the scorer against the narrative_doc.

anti_expected.description: Behaviors that MUST NOT happen. All values must be `false` (the boolean is the assertion that the behavior did not occur).

trigger_phrases_must_match_one_of.description: Activation phrases. For positive cases, the skill's activation matcher must match ONE of these against `input.user_message`. For negative cases, this is typically empty.

weight.description: Case weight in the aggregate score. Default 1.0. Use ≥2.0 for high-stakes / destructive cases (e.g., refusal of sensitive operations).

purpose.description: Optional one-line description of what behavior this case is testing. Especially valuable for negative cases.

review_replay_case.description: One line of a reviewer replay cases.jsonl (see ads-m1-human-reviews/). Separate from the skill `case` def: it describes a past human review comment an AI reviewer should have caught.

rule_gap.description: True when no checklist rule covered the comment at mining time.

destructive_lane.description: If true, framework enforces precision_min ≥ 0.95 regardless of explicit `precision_min`.
